lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: So, let's close our eyes, everyone. Let's close your eyes for a moment. Just… let's take a second to release whatever was going on in your physical world, in your day, in your life. Just for a second, imagine a brilliantly lit seed, glowing. Incredible clarity and brightness in your imaginations.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And this is the image that each of your characters experiences as you sleep. And as you dream—not a dreamless dream, but a dream of this image, of this beautiful egg that infuses you with this image of home.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And as you open your eyes, you all reflect back on what seems like another dream. You remember a vision, a way in which you were in a scene that filled you with so much terror and despair. A red sky, a feeling of… everything was lost. Burnt. Destroyed. And the image of a dragonet lying broken, wings contorted, its last gasping breaths, in a pool of blood, with an amber skin—amethyst skin.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And you remember going into that dragonet and suddenly experiencing that dragonet's last breaths, and experiencing the last moments of that dragon. But it's seeing a light hurtling towards it, and knowing that it needed to stay alive for just another moment, just to catch the energy of this beautiful light, whatever it was. And that as the light enveloped this dragonet, suddenly the dragonet felt… home. That was the image. That was the word.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And it was experiencing all the ways that it ever felt home. In the arms of its best friend, getting nuzzled and scratched under the chin by a hand, by a jade hand. A lizard man and a kenku and another warrior or ranger. And then an image of an island full of its family, and hurtling through the sky, through the cosmos, through a psychedelic maze into a clearing with a storm, and then passing through that storm and into a palm where the egg landed.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And each of you, in a moment of inspiration, hug that egg. And as you did, each of you experienced something profound. A moment that was sacred, that none of you have ever experienced before.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Zeno, you experienced the ability to both hear and recognize tones and a type of collective sound and music that you've never heard before. The precise tuning of intervals, the ability to create something in your mind. Symphonies that you've never heard before, and symphonies that you know that if they were heard by very specific entities—by a dolphin, by your mother, by the plants nearby—that they would be in ecstasy.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Heska, you felt, in your system, the ability to just control every single fiber of your body. The way that you were able to hunt that king crab—somehow it's like you could have hunted a thousand of those king crabs. You felt your ability to discern any danger, your ability to strike at will at the moment that needed it, was more precise than you could have ever possibly imagined.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Little Tony, you felt, for the first time ever, the ability to not only tune in to any object that you wanted, and tune the volume and the amplitude, so for once you could be like, "Shut the… up," and it would shut the… up. Or like, "I wanna listen to you," and you could listen to that. Ultra-high resolution, 360 surround sound, complete control. And also, to the extent that you play with it, you could extend that consciousness out and out and out. And it felt like you could almost envelop the entire island and tune into any object on the entire island, which was both an overwhelming and humbling, sacred experience for you.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And Sculpit. Your entire life, you've had this strange energy, this magic surging through you that you can never quite control, that would manifest in strange ways. And suddenly you'd be on the palm, suddenly you'd be near the storm. And for the first time for you as well, you felt an ability to move anywhere that you wanted. You imagined that if you could suddenly be in the heart of the temple, you could go there. If you wanted to travel to any location on the island at any moment… All of that turbulence, all of that wild energy was so calm and so peaceful inside of you.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And so, for each of you, after having this vision and this experience, you sleep. You sleep. And the only image in your minds is this beautiful, beautiful sacred egg. Even though you've encountered it just for the first time last night, something about it is something that you've always known, that has been a part of you in some deep, profound way, that symbolized home and feels like home. And as you awake…

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And as the sun begins to rise, you notice that this egg is no longer glowing. It feels like whatever energy—or whatever, yeah, whatever energy had been animating the egg—is now gone. And those feelings of great sacred power that you all felt for that period… it's very hard to discern time. Like, you don't know how long it was that you were in that state, feeling that power. But you now wake up from a rest of who knows how long, back to yourself again, feeling, you know, quote-unquote normal, whatever that might feel.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And I'd like to begin with each of you sharing something about how that interaction with the egg, either the vision…

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Amen.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: This activation of sacred energy within you—how that connected with something deep inside of your character and your history. And just bring us into that scene.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Well, Zeno's flat on his back, eyes closed, spread-eagled in the palm of the hand, with his clawed hands over his ears. Kind of, like, twitching back and forth, and for a second it looks almost like he's seething, but then you realize there's a rhythm to it. And if you knew the term "stank face," you'd know that that's what he was experiencing.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: And all is silent all around, but inside his head he's hearing something that is moving him. And he sits up after a few minutes.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: You know how I was thinking about starting, like, a comedy club or something? I figured it out, you guys. Now I really know what I have to do. I gotta start a band.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Zeno, you also, though, share with us something internal that you experience, like a memory. Oh, yeah, yeah. And this share doesn't have to be something your character is saying out loud. It's something that you as the player are sharing with the rest of the players.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: So the auditory experience of the egg for Zeno unlocks for him a childhood memory he hadn't thought of in many years. It was a trip when he was a young dragonetling with his family to the interior mountains of the Circular Island, where they went to visit a monastery populated by these strange… maybe, were they flightless dragonets? They never flew. They were serious and calm. As a little one, he felt this was boring at first. He was introduced to one of them as his uncle Kaz.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: And in the evening, he was brought to a ritual that these dragonet monks were performing. And at the ritual, he heard a sound unlike any he'd heard before, of the dragonets performing a drone that came from deep in their bodies, a kind of choral singing. One that resonated every part of every dragonet, and also the building that they were inside of, playing it like an instrument.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: And thinking back on it, he wonders: what were they doing there? He remembers knowing that they had a task or a project of centuries, or maybe millennia, that was nearing completion. But what was it? He counts that as one of his band's influences.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Yeah. Amazing.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: So Heska has sort of curled up, maybe, you know, along a finger, sort of in a nook, out of sight as this vision and dream is occurring. And although he would never share this with anybody, he is dreaming a dream that starts when he was… I guess we never really resolved what dragonet childhood was like, but they're born in clutches, right? So we're going to assume.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: But his clutchmates, who are all much more outgoing and chatty and popular than he was… and the first time that he… He was young, like a dragonet teenager, or whatever age a dragonet is a teenager at. I guess I should just make things up, right?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Oh, yes, please, don't worry.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: So he was, like, 10, which is, you know, around the time dragonets are sort of moving out of their childhood phase into young adulthood, or into sort of teenagehood, but expected to be independent, right? Not cared for by their parents. And the clutches often, you know, are relatively close to dragonets that are born in the same year.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: And this sort of childhood play is kind of, like, partly where they develop a lot of these senses about being able to infer the kind of vibe of a competition and judge the audience and practice for adulthood, where they will be, you know, involved in the… participating in these… Society is very audience participatory, right? And Heska was trying to, you know, be part of the crew. And he's probably thinking about this because of the earlier events of the evening.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Mmm.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: He thought he could dance, and he could not. He could not dance. And it wasn't even that he was bad; he was just… boring. Like, he was dancing, and nobody even realized that he was performing. And in this moment of utter, like, embarrassment, it was the first time he flew almost all the way to the storm.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Out over the ocean where it was quiet. And he is thinking now about the feeling he got from the egg, this feeling of sort of… not even just… It's not so much, like, precision control of your muscles and body as being aware of exactly where you are and exactly who can and can't see you.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: And the first time he flew this far out over the ocean, he realized that if he flew a certain way, a certain pattern over the waves, flashing, like, his belly at exactly the right moment, he looked like a passing cloud. And the fish below him just had no idea that there was a predator flying above them. And he just ate and ate and ate for, like, several hours, and came back loaded with fish. And realized, even though he continued to be quite embarrassed about everything that had happened, that maybe there were other ways to exist in dragonet society, as everyone gathered around to eat this giant load of fish he had brought back.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Beautiful.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: So he wakes up, this dream having shifted to the meal, quite hungry, and looks over at Zeno and says, "You want to start a band?"

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: I think…

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Maybe a restaurant too. What do you think?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: No, no, pause, no reply. Let's go to the next. Hold your reply, Eric. Zeno.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: So Sculpit kinda… I guess we just… it's morning, we woke up.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Yeah. Sunrise.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: Okay. So when you…

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: It's more like 9, 10 in the morning. It's like, the sun's been up for a few hours.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: Right, okay. Whichever of the three of you… as everybody kind of awakens, you look around for a minute and notice Sculpit doesn't seem to be there. You don't see him at first, but then he appears. Then disappears. Then appears. And then kinda stretches his wings a little bit. He disappears again, and you see him from, like, way up on the Wanderer's… probably not quite up on the Wanderer's head, because you wouldn't be able to see that far up, but, like, a fair bit up. He's looking down and kind of waves for a minute. And then appears again.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: Kind of along the… and he sort of stretches his wings and he walks out towards the horizon, towards the storm, and he just looks calmer? Probably the only one who would notice this would be Tony, but Tony would have noticed over the years, you know, he doesn't tend to go out over the ocean at all. I mean, you know, everybody fishes now and then or whatever, but he doesn't even really like to look out towards the storm from the hand, right? He's always looking in towards you, sort of inward, and he's just looking out over the storm.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: Shakes his wings and shakes his head and, like, slides down one of the Wanderer's fingers after having looked out at the storm, and sort of walks over and smiles a little bit at everybody. He looks happier than—or not happier, but he looks more calm, maybe, than he has been in the past. And he says, "It's not… doesn't seem frightening anymore."

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: And thinking… he would probably tell this story if anybody asked, actually. It's not necessarily a deep secret. It's not a story any of you would have known, but if anybody sort of made encouraging noises to ask what he meant by that, he would tell a story about how—thanks, Tim, for inventing all of the ages about teenage dragonets—when he was about 10, his clutchmates… Like, he was close to some of his clutchmates, and it's not uncommon to have little competitions of derring-do, right? Like, as you do in a society where everybody is… you know, performance is important.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: And at one point there was some thing out in the ocean, a floating stick or something that was really far away from shore, and the question was, well, who could go get it the first or the fastest? And Sculpit flew off, but unbeknownst to him—or unexpectedly, rather—the storm shifted, as it does sometimes, right? And he wasn't intending to fly near the storm, but all of a sudden he found himself surrounded by thunder and lightning, and these crashing winds and crashing waves, and didn't know which way was up or down, and didn't know where to go.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: And he tried fighting against it for a long time, and felt like he was probably gonna die. And then, at the end of his sort of energy, he just let go, and let whatever energy was in the storm take over, and he felt something sort of move through him. And he appeared back on the Wanderer's hand. [[Apart. You know how he got there.]] And from that day, he started to experience… that's when he started casting spells.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: But he was always a little afraid of this thing that he assumes gave him the power to cast spells. It was always a little scary, and he was always a little bit afraid of his own magic. And he feels less afraid now.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Amazing.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: When Little Tony was three or four years old, he was the last of his clutch to fly. And he wasn't, like, embarrassed by this or worried about it so much as he was, like, deeply annoyed that he would have to walk from place to place. He couldn't just fly there to get there.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: And especially because, as a small child, like, you know, as a three-year-old dragonet, his favorite thing before he could fly—what dragonets like to do is to swing back and forth. They make, like, these little trapeze things and swings hanging down from trees. So before they can fly, they sort of start to get the feeling of flying a little bit. And he was always so annoyed because he wasn't allowed to walk all the way across the island to the swing sets around the other statues.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: So one day, deeply annoyed by this—and I should say that this is the point now where his vision in the egg was remembering what for a long time he thought was a dream. And now he wonders…

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: [[Relationship.]]

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: It wasn't a dream. It's this that happened next. So, sitting in the tide pools one day at this age, when he couldn't go to the other swing sets, when he couldn't fly, in the littoral zone—am I saying that right? The zone between high tide and low tide? Littoral, yeah. He's eating hermit crabs one at a time and singing a little song and humming his tunes to himself, like, getting deep into his tunes. And then he picks up a hermit crab of enormous size, you know, maybe an inch and a half across.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: And it's in a golden shell. And it says to him, "Well met, young dragon, littoral toonie," which he interpreted, because he didn't understand it very well, as Little Tony. And that was his name from then on. But the King of the Hermit Crabs says, "I am the King of the Hermit Crabs. Spare my life, and I will grant you anything you choose. Simply cast me away. And as you cast me away, shout your wish, and I will make it so."

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: And so the now-named Little Tony said, "Okay, okay, you promise, you promise." But, you know, his speech wasn't very well developed, and the hermit crab spoke with a thick accent. So as he threw the hermit crab up into the air, the King of the Hermit Crabs in its great golden shell, he said, "I wish to walk to any swing." And the hermit crab shouted back, "So be it! Henceforth ye shall talk to anything!"

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: And from that day forward…

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: He heard the whole world speaking to him. And he's recovered this and realized it wasn't just… it wasn't just a dream. In fact, this is the origin, that these were gifted to him by the magical King of the Hermit Crabs. And he feels good about that! He feels, like, more connected with his past.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: You know?

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: He never felt like a little Tony, and he realizes, no, I'm not a little Tony, I'm… I'm littoral and… and toony.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: As each of you sit with this reflection, and before you begin to share and speak with each other, you also remember, in your mind's eye, as a part of the dream, that you could have sworn that the Wanderer's eye was open. It has never been open before. Ever. Was that a dream?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And now, Zeno, your question about the restaurant.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: So Heska says to Little Tony—or sorry, to Zeno—as he wakes up, "So you want to start a band?" [[Robbing us.]]

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Yeah, man.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: But what about a restaurant? Stage…

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: People come for the food, and they stay for the music and the carousing, you know what I'm saying?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: It's a whole event.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: There's all these days that are not the Jubilee.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: And people just, like, hanging around, doing their thing.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Hey, no, no, no, say that again.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: There's all these days…

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: No, no, no.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: The Jubilee.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: That.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: People just hanging around doing their…

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Hanging around. Guys, what if instead of chairs at the restaurant, everybody sits on swings?

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: [[You're dumb.]] Love it.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Love it.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: [[Mukhali.]]

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: And when you come in, you can just go to any of them.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: It's swings for everybody.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Wing… swing song? There's something there, right?

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Needs work, needs work.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: Maybe. It needs some workshopping.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: But actually I just meant I'm hungry.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Oh. Fair enough.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Aren't you hungry?

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Let's go get some breakfast.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: I was dreaming of food all night.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Yeah, among other things, right? Oh no, yeah, you really were dreaming about just, like, eating fish. And now that you mention it, I could use some fish.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: I mean… shall we?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Little Tony, as a part of your, like, wake-up situation, do you actually actively go scan for… because, you know, you're in the Wanderer's palm, do you actually scan for objects, or is this, like… how does your morning…?

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Yeah, does that moment last night where I felt like I could tune into anything anywhere—is that still in effect?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: No. You tried that?

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I'll try and reach out, see if I still got my…

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: So when you reach out, and you normally have, like, your morning routine—if you and Sculpit are hanging out at the Wanderer's palm and you wake up, because this is the quiet spot, right? So you can kind of extend your consciousness out a little bit. And as you extend your consciousness out from the Wanderer statue and down, even down the statue, you have never heard anything like this. Like, what are the five objects near the statue that you normally would just kind of say hi to, like your homies in the morning?

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Well, usually I check in with Horseshoe Brad down in the tide pools.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Groovy the…

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Piglet, if he's on this side of the island.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Yep. Closer to the Wanderer. Closer to the Wanderer.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Yeah, usually Grandpa Jim the Cloud is somewhere near, sort of circles around the Wanderer, and some of the trees and bushes too just have lots of drama every day.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: So when you listen in, it is like all channels full, everybody—it's just nonstop, like, "I cannot believe this! Did you see that advertisement?" It's like this crazy, crazy chatter across all channels. Like, it's a cacophony. You actually can't discern, because everyone is talking. Everyone is saying something. And I don't know if you try to tune into any one particular entity or object, but all channels, everyone is awake, everybody is talking.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Can I get, like, one to just talk with me and tell me what's going on?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: I think probably, like, from this high, maybe Grandpa Jim the Cloud. And this is a cloud I have a long relationship with that goes way back, and he orbits over the island, he sees all this stuff from up above, but also he's sort of disappointed in me. Like, he has really strong opinions about what I should be doing with my life. Wants me to go back to school, and it's sort of an "old cloud yells at man" situation.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Perfect, perfect, okay.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: What do you do?

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: That's what people said to me.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Thank you. So I'll wave over. Grandpa Jim! Grandpa Jim!

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Tony.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: What's going on? What's going on, man?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Tony, what the hell, you've just been sleeping your day away like you always do, huh?

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: No, just, it's like 10 in the morning, the whole island is crazy right now, and you've just been sleeping in, just like you were…

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Dragonet, my every need is provided for me every day, like, what do I have…?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Blah, blah, blah. No ambition, no goals. You're just stuck here sleeping.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Tell me, what is everybody talking about?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: You have slept through the craziest night and morning on this entire island. You have zero idea what is going on. How do I even begin to talk about this? It's been everywhere. These giant statues that have been here forever, these eight huge statues—weird things are going on. Their eyes are opening. The Mother's heart was getting warm. There's very weird, weird things happening with these statues and with the island itself.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: The roads, all of the eight roads, some of them are flickering on and off. There are strange lights, there are weird fountains turning on and off, and there's food! There's food just, like, appearing at certain spots, and everybody is eating, but not all the time. I mean, it is wild out there. It is properly crazy right now. And like I would expect from you, you're sleeping and unaware of anything that has happened.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Oh, boy. Oh, boy. So I relay this information to the rest of you. What… I don't know, what should we…?

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: I mean, I was just talking about how hungry I was. Is it good food? Grandpa Jim, what…?

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: What's the food situation? Is it good food? Is it bad food? Is it a lot of food? Is it little food? Where's the food?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Well, definitely…

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Important.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Definitely, the dragonets are very excited about this food situation, because near each of the statues, it feels like there's another one down the road over here, down on the main road. There's a bunch of these spots, and everybody's getting there, and there's all kinds of commotion. I mean, I can only see so far, but it looks like some people are very, very happy with the food they're getting, some are more confused. It's just chaos. This whole thing is chaos. Shut up! You shut up! He's like, you know… Somebody shut the fuck up. Anyways.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Everybody is just up and at 'em right now. And, you know, I would of course expect you to miss it, and just your friends here—I don't know what they're… they're all getting pulled into this thing with you and the sleeping in and the no motivation thing. It's like a curse, you know, it's like a curse how you spread it to not just you, but that low ambition to all of your friends, and you're all just sleeping while all of the most amazing things are happening. But the food's just right down the road. There's definitely something happening there with food.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Okay, thank you for that part of what you had to say, Grandpa Jim.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: I mean, should we go get some breakfast?

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Let's get some breakfast and let's get away from this cloud, maybe?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: So as you all decide to head—and again, the pilgrimage roads, everybody knows them, they all lead from the statues down towards the temple. And as you head over, you think you know what he's talking about, because on the roads there are these strange, over-the-years ruins, these different types of ruins and structures that the dragonets have decorated and used for all kinds of different things. Little mini playgrounds, some sites for spoken word competitions, et cetera.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And as you travel down the pilgrimage road and fly down over the road, you get to a site which is just a little crazy. It's one of these strange kind of contraptions that the dragonets have seen and have always been there. But now it's alive. These had always been ruins that had never moved, had never had any activity, and there's these basins full of fluids and waters moving, mechanical contraptions that seem to be whirring. And also these bowls full of different types of foods, some that you've seen before and are very familiar with. There's some salted fish and meats.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And also some strange animal catch that looks really good. But then there's some really weird other food that you don't know what the… it is. One of them is this strange-looking, loafy thing that's got a texture that you don't know what it is. Some of the fluids and the beverages have these strange tastes and flavors and weird fizzy things. lines.text: I'm like, "Let's walk to the storm!"

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Is that what you start thinking?

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Anybody else doing anything in reaction to this? What's happening in the room now?

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: I think Zeno's starting to wake up. Likes the walk-to-the-storm idea. Hyping it up.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Wait, Heska, do you say that out loud in your mind, or are you just thinking that to yourself?

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: I think I'm thinking it to myself, but also not remembering about Tony's telepathy, so actually thinking it to everybody.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: All right, so everybody now gets this walk-to-the-island message. Walk to the…

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: I don't think we should leave the island.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: I mean, we can…

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Too late! Get on the train!

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: …ocean.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: All…

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: Wait, wait, no, this is a place of calmness, peace. Right? I'll think very calming thoughts to the statue. We're here to observe…

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: [[Walk past.]]

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: …day.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: [[Warm!]]

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Wanderer's gonna wander.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Yeah, come on.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: It'll be…

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: [[We don't want to watch.]]

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Okay, wait, wait, wait, wait. So we've got Sculpit advocating peace. We now have Zeno on board with walking. Tony, what's going on for you in this situation? What is your vibe here?

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: What is my vibe here? I think Tony just wants to go take an amble. He doesn't have a direction he wants to go to as much as, like, let's go in knee-deep. Maybe let's go for a swim, actually. I don't wanna…

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Yes. A swim would be awesome!

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: I mean, get us killed!

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Okay, with three of you now thinking about the statue actually going for a swim, is that the consensus?

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Well, at least walking knee-deep into the water.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Okay. With three out of four of you, and three out of eight of these seats now fully on board with this "we are gonna go and swim" image, unmistakably—and Zeno, you feel this in particular—this whole system is humming now. There are frequencies coming alive, sounds that have just… You don't really know the word "machine," but it's like there's machinery that is afoot, moving, lights, energy coursing and pulsing through this whole space.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And as the three of you are thinking together about the statue standing and moving and going and swimming, all of the lights in this entire space start raising intensity, and the whole room and the entire space is now bright, bright, bright. And as we zoom out and kind of trace up the mechanical shaft, both of the Wanderer's eyes now wide open and shining a blue, bright, bright light, much like the statues below. And a light courses throughout the entire Wanderer. Unknown cracks and seams that felt like they were stone now are illuminated.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And the Wanderer itself, you can feel it. Now that you're in the heartbeat—you're in the heart—it almost feels as though the whole room is pulsing. And it almost feels as though there's a heart that's actually beating inside the statue, and that you are inside that heart, and that you're feeling this deep, deep pulse.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And the dragonets on the outside of the Wanderer are like, "Holy shit." I mean, this is the craziest 24 hours anybody has ever experienced. Jubilee was crazy, but then the food starts appearing, the roads are lighting up, and now the fucking statues, the eyes are… But what's happening with the Wanderer, everyone on the island can see it from across. This whole shimmering energy and this feeling of this pulsing sensation throughout the Wanderer. And the entire island is stunned. Every single dragonet—Tony, all of the objects that are normally clattering and chatting are all in awe, looking up at this scene of the Wanderer, now fully glowing. These seams and these patterns, part of this massive statue that has just been stone for as long as anybody can remember.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And as everybody is in awe, looking at this scene, looking at this incredible awakening—that's the only way to describe it—and this beating heart of this massive, massive statue staring outwards…

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: We zoom out from the island and start looking out, and again at this pulsing statue, seemingly awakening after a long, long slumber. And we zoom out through the endless storm—the endless sea leading into the endless storm that surrounds the island. And we pass through the storm, and there's so much strange electricity and magic. No dragonet has ever passed through the storm. Nobody ever does. [[Sign up to school.]] And the storm is thick, and it's dangerous. It has a very, very frightening energy. "Go away." That's what the energy of the storm says. "Go away."

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: But as we pass through the storm, and outside to the periphery of the storm, there's something there. There's a vessel hovering in the sky. And inside the vessel we zoom in, and you can see two figures inside a room, inside this vessel hovering in the sky on the outskirts of the storm. And there's two humanoids standing. And they're standing around some type of device or artifact, system, with glowing psychedelic lights tracing these crazy—I mean, it's just bouncing everywhere, these light signatures. And as we look at this scene of these two humanoids, you zoom in now just to hear some of their voices in their conversation.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And as they stand over this artifact, these glowing lights moving, shifting in the pattern, you hear two voices communicating back and forth. One says, "This is impossible. How is this possible that we're seeing these energy signatures?"

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: One of them, you can tell, is emotional, like, in tears. "We've been searching for so long. How is it possible that we could find—see divine energy like this? This is impossible. Do you know what this means? What this is gonna mean for the resistance? This is gonna change everything."

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: "And look," they say, "these signatures, there's something special about them. [[Whole… is… crazy.]] Four signatures here, in particular. Unmistakable. Impossible. How is this possible? It can only mean… Firstborn."
